name: Spiritual Attack
overview: Scripture reveals that believers face spiritual attacks from the enemy whose intent is to steal, kill, and destroy, as Jesus was tempted in the wilderness (Matthew 4:1; John 10:10). However, God promises protection and victory to His servants, assuring that no weapon formed against them will prosper and that they can live securely under His care (Isaiah 54:17; Psalms 91:1). Through Christ, believers are empowered to overcome the enemy's power and are assured that their prayers offered in Jesus' name will be answered (Luke 10:19; John 14:14).
